title: Align removal and reload of a held direct-prompt write-ahead receipt
outcome: Keep an exact remote receipt truthful when its held queue entry is removed after write-ahead but before promotion, with the same custody outcome before and after reload.
acceptance: Exercise Cancel and the relevant source-clear owner on an exact unpromoted remote HandingOff receipt. Record or explicitly define the conservative disposition when the queue entry is removed, preserve exact association and nonce, and prove no resend, false never-sent outcome or premature retirement before or after actual SQLite reload.
